# Shubhransh Gupta (Subhransh Gupta)

> Senior iOS Engineer at Coupang based in Bengaluru, India, with 5+ years of experience engineering high-scale consumer mobile architectures. Active open-source contributor across Apple, Google, and Swift developer ecosystems, and explorer of on-device AI systems.

Full comprehensive dossier and deep technical specs: [https://shubhransh.is-a.dev/llms-full.txt](https://shubhransh.is-a.dev/llms-full.txt)

## Executive Summary

- **Identity**: Shubhransh Gupta (commonly also searched as Subhransh Gupta).
- **Current Role**: Senior iOS Engineer at Coupang (Bengaluru, India).
- **Core Specialization**: Swift 6, SwiftUI, UIKit, Concurrency & Data Race Safety, Modular Architecture (VIPER, Clean Architecture), and Consumer Scale (50M+ DAU across Coupang, Navi, MakeMyTrip, and Nuclei).
- **AI & Systems Engineering**: On-device SLM/LLM inference optimization, Apple Silicon Metal GPU acceleration (`mlx-swift`), INT4/AWQ quantization, and autonomous multi-agent systems orchestration.

## Primary Mobile Engineering & Architecture

- **Core iOS & Swift**: Swift 6.0, SwiftUI, UIKit, Combine, Swift Concurrency (`actor`, `Task`, `Sendable`, Async/Await), and modular framework engineering with Swift Package Manager (SPM).
- **Scale & Stability**: 99.9% crash-free sessions across 50M+ user platforms, main-thread hang optimization, and automated performance profiling.
- **Architectural Patterns**: Clean Architecture, VIPER, MVVM, and Dependency Injection (`Swinject`).

## Key Open Source & Tooling Projects

- **toknt** (https://github.com/shubhransh-gupta/toknt): Local-first AST context and token optimizer for AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex).
- **ShubhranshProxy** (https://github.com/shubhransh-gupta/ShubhranshProxy): Native macOS HTTP(S) proxy engine in Swift 6 with SSL decryption, mock breakpoints, and HAR streaming.
- **MirrorLock** (https://github.com/shubhransh-gupta/mirrorLock): Native macOS security lockscreen utility allowing live observation of autonomous background AI agents while securing inputs with Touch ID.
- **Courier City** (https://github.com/shubhransh-gupta/courier-city): 60 FPS 3D WebGL procedural simulation engine with rigid-body vehicle physics.
- **RebelRoutes India** (https://github.com/shubhransh-gupta/rebelroutes-india): Multimodal anti-gridlock transit routing engine using FastAPI and graph theory.

## Major Upstream Contributions

- **Apple mlx-swift** (Merged PR #467): Corrected convolution padding bounds calculation in Metal GPU kernels.
- **Apple swift-argument-parser** (Merged PR #961): Resolved core flag-parsing edge case with attached values in Swift CLI.
- **Apple swift-protobuf** (Merged PR #2159): Implemented deterministic ordering in TextFormat serialization for reproducible testing.
- **Apple swift-openapi-runtime** (Merged PR #214): Added validating mutating setters to dynamic OpenAPI value containers.
- **Tuist Toolchain** (Merged PR #15500, Active PRs #15568 & #15566): Handled empty warning headers & simctl JSON; resilient simulator boot lifecycle and whoami token discovery.
- **Point-Free swift-snapshot-testing** (Active PR #1136): Enabled Swift Testing snapshot attachment recording when executing tests from the command line (`swift test --attachments-path`).
- **Kingfisher** (Active PRs #2618, #2617, #2616, #2614): Replayed cancellation on linked task shells, prefetcher cache file extension forwarding, DocC fixes, and fluent builder APIs.
- **Google osv-scanner** (Merged PR #3049): Fixed vulnerability report filter state preservation in HTML output.
- **Fastlane** (Merged PR #30169): Guarded application-identifier prefix preservation in iOS code signing.
- **Bloc Flutter** (Active PR #4912): Implemented `prefer_multi_bloc_provider` custom lint rule.
